story: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price FINNIFTY to move about ±4.3%, roughly 27,231 to 29,684. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 62% of the time.
Options are cheap compared with how much FINNIFTY has actually been moving: they price 18.4% a year while the last month realised 22.6%.
FINNIFTY has actually been moving about 1.43% a day this past month: on the high side for it against the past year.

For the 2026-12-29 expiry, the biggest pile of call positions is at 29,000 (+2.3% away) and the biggest pile of put positions is at 28,000 (-1.2%). Option sellers defend these levels, so price often slows near them, but they shift as positions change.

vrp.simple: Options are cheap compared with how much FINNIFTY has actually been moving: they price 18.4% a year while the last month realised 22.6%.

Since 2021-01-11, IV30 was above the volatility that actually followed over the next 21 sessions on 62% of days: option sellers are usually paid a premium for carrying the risk, and the gap is what that premium looks like today.

skew.analyst: 25-delta risk reversal -1.23 vol pts (front month), 52nd percentile of the past year. More negative = more demand for downside insurance relative to upside.
